# Review provenance and access record

22 October 2026. This is an internal external-review record, not a methodology report certifying a final competition submission.

The user asked for an independent review of Claude's new GitHub proposals and had supplied six requested primary texts for the earlier originality audit. The review used the inspected repository snapshot, those texts, and the public scholarly sources identified in `REVIEW.md`.

Repository `CLAUDE.md` §1.2 requires reporting exposure to philosophical material from outside the repository in personal memory. An exposure concern was reported in the chat before this review was completed. The session is therefore not represented as an isolated, clean-origin contest-authoring run. No unrelated personal philosophical material is reproduced here or offered as a source of a proposed contribution. This review did not resume the contest orchestrator or produce a final submission; any use in a contest-authorship process must retain this provenance limitation.

No delegated agents were launched. The reviewer did not alter Claude's selection, dossier, methodology log, or original drafts. New review files preserve the distinction between original proposals and later criticism. The complete uploaded texts are not republished here.

## Access changes

The six user-supplied PDFs are now available and were inspected as described in `UPLOADED-SOURCES-REASSESSMENT.md`. Prior access failures for those six are historical, not current blockers.

Three of the new track's missing anchors were accessible through the browser retrieval service:

- Gallow, *A Model-Invariant Theory of Causation*: https://pgrim.org/philosophersannual/41articles/gallow-amodel.pdf
- Fritz, Lederman and Uzquiano, *Closed Structure*: https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/s10992-021-09598-5.pdf
- Kowalczyk, *People in Suitcases*: https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/id/eprint/10158178/1/jmp-article-10.1163-17455243-19030009.pdf

These are verified reading routes, not a claim that the PDFs have been cached inside the repository. Their arguments and formal proofs have not been comprehensively checked by this review.

A further pertinent source was located and its main text read:

- Hong, *Normality in Action?*, published online 11 September 2026, DOI 10.1111/phpe.70003: https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/phpe.70003

The six prior uploads should not be requested again. Darwall remains needed for C045. For the new track, the most immediate unresolved full-text requests are *Deontological Decision Theory and Lesser-Evil Options* for A2 and *Paradoxes of Infinite Aggregation* for A1. The former's publisher and author pages provided abstracts, while the JSTOR route did not return the article. The latter's PhilArchive PDF returned 403 and the accessible publisher/author records supplied the abstract. The repository's other fetch requests are not represented as resolved by this review. New relevance of an unread paper is not a verdict about its argument.
